_comment: Build log on about.html — newest first, and NOT derived from apps.json on purpose. These are dated journal entries: 'three apps in App Review, July 2026' stays true after they ship, so regenerating it from current status would rewrite history. Add an entry at the top and run tools/sync.py.
heading: Build log
blurb: Notes from building in the open. Newest first.

entries.title: Four apps at Apple at once
entries.body: Feastmark, PayoffPilot and ReelTalk went into App Review and Gunmark opened a TestFlight beta. I wrote up what shipping them together actually cost — including a signup form that told people to check their inbox while subscribing nobody: Four Apps at Apple at Once.

entries.title: Gunmark joins the lineup
entries.body: Gunmark — a private firearm collection catalog with zero network calls — opened beta signups and joined the site alongside Feastmark, PayoffPilot, and ReelTalk.

entries.title: Feastmark, PayoffPilot & ReelTalk in App Review
entries.body: Feastmark, PayoffPilot, and ReelTalk are in Apple's review queue — coming soon to the App Store.

entries.title: Rebuilt the site as one design system
entries.body: Pulled every page onto a shared stylesheet so the whole studio reads as one thing — and gave PayoffPilot a public Now / Next / Later roadmap.

entries.title: From late-night code to a studio
entries.body: Started learning to code after the kids went to bed, became a software engineer, and turned that into Big Beard Apps — building the private, useful apps I wanted for myself.
